fullDescription: A high-end editorial portfolio design featuring minimalist brutalism, sophisticated serif typography, and kinetic motion. The aesthetic is defined by a warm off-white background (#eeede9), high-contrast black typography, and responsive viewport-based font sizing. Suitable for luxury fashion, creative agencies, architect portfolios, and high-fashion digital experiences. Key features include a custom interactive cursor, sticky typographic overlays, and scroll-triggered fade animations using custom cubic-bezier curves.

structured.summary: A minimalist, typography-centric design system utilizing extreme scale contrasts, warm neutral tones, and elegant serif/sans-serif pairings. The layout relies heavily on sticky positioning and viewport-dependent spacing to create a dynamic, magazine-like digital experience.

style.description: The style is an 'editorial brutalism' mix. It pairs a primary serif font (Ogg Roman/Slant) for emotional weight and artistic headers with a sharp, geometric sans-serif (Attila Sans Sharp) for functional links and metadata. The color palette is strictly limited to a warm beige background and pitch-black text. Micro-interactions are defined by smooth opacity transitions and a custom circular cursor that tracks movement with ease-out physics.
style.prompt: Apply a base theme with background-color: #eeede9 and text-color: #000000. Typography: Headers use a high-contrast Serif (e.g., Ogg Roman) at fluid sizes (up to 33.75vw), while functional text uses a sharp geometric Sans-Serif (e.g., Attila Sans Sharp) at small sizes (0.9vw - 1.5vw). Use font-style: italic (Slant) for stylistic emphasis within words. Links must have a transition: opacity 0.3s cubic-bezier(.645,.045,.355,1) and fade to opacity: 0 on hover. Interactive elements: Implement a fixed cursor container with a 15px x 15px black circle (#000) that follows the pointer using transform: translate3d. Scroll animations: Use data-in-view triggers to toggle opacity from 0 to 1 with a 1s duration and a cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94) timing function.

layout_and_structure.description: A vertical-scrolling editorial layout using sticky containers to overlap large-scale text over central imagery. Content is organized in high-impact blocks with generous viewport-based padding.

prompts.prompt: Create a 200vh height container with a 100vh sticky hero section. Center a fluid image (approx 47vw) in the middle. Layer a massive sticky H1 over the image. The text should be split into two lines: top line (lowercase, letter-spacing: -0.11em) and bottom line (uppercase, letter-spacing: -0.04em, font-size: 33.75vw, line-height: 69%). The name should feel like it is wrapping around or behind the central image via z-index management.

A text block using uppercase Serif typography at 5vw font-size. Line-height should be tight (0.98em). On desktop, align this block to the right with a 1.5vw padding. Implement scroll-triggered word-by-word fade-in animations.

A hidden-on-mobile, visible-on-desktop section. Use 16px font-size for body text. Incorporate lowercase italics for specific mentions. Padding should be 2vw on each side. The text is dense and editorial, functioning as a texture block.

Create an ordered list (<ol>) where items follow a three-step staggered alignment pattern: 1. Text-align: Left, 2. Text-align: Center, 3. Text-align: Right. Typography: Uppercase Serif at 5.7vw. Each item should have a hover effect where the entire link fades toward transparency (opacity: 0). Use font-style: italic for prefix labels (e.g., 'nyc', 'sqsp').

A footer featuring the current year or copyright symbol at an extreme scale (28.9vw font-size). Line-height: 0.85em. The typography should be Serif Roman, with the numbers partially in Slant/Italic. Center-align the text and set it to a negative z-index so it sits behind other page content if they overlap.

special_ui_components.description: A minimalist black dot that follows the mouse with a slight lag/smoothing.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create a fixed 15px black circle (#000) with border-radius: 50%. Position it fixed at top: 0, left: 0. Disable pointer-events. Use JavaScript to update its transform: translate3d based on mouse coordinates, adding a lerp (linear interpolation) or CSS transition (transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(.075,.82,.165,1)) for smooth trailing motion.

special_ui_components.description: Text that slides and fades into view as the user scrolls.
special_ui_components.prompt: Wrap lines of text in span elements with 'display: inline-block'. Set initial state to 'opacity: 0' and 'transform: translate(0, 20px)'. When the element enters the viewport (intersecting), transition to 'opacity: 1' and 'transform: translate(0,0)' over 1s using cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94).

structured.special_notes: MUST-DO: Use fluid typography (vw units) for all large headers to ensure the layout remains proportional to the window size. MUST-DO: Implement a 'cursor: none' on the HTML/Body when the custom cursor is active. MUST-NOT: Use traditional underlines or color shifts for hover states; the fade-to-invisible (opacity: 0) effect is central to the brand identity. MUST-DO: Use tight negative letter-spacing on large headings to create a 'brutalist' typeface feel.
